title: Earnings Guarantee Opt-In and the Locked Guarantee
content:
## Terms of the opt-in

Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, an earnings guarantee opt-in is the driver's own action; it is open only for the account's upcoming earnings guarantee, which is the earnings guarantee offer with the latest window start on the account, and only before that window starts. The opt-in records the locked guarantee, the guaranteed amount the driver is held to for that window.

Once an opt-in is recorded, the earnings guarantee for that offer pays the locked guarantee on the opt-in less the window earnings, when positive, provided the driver was online at least the offer's required online minutes, kept an acceptance rate of at least the guarantee's minimum acceptance rate and a cancellation rate of at most the guarantee's maximum cancellation rate over the window. The window earnings are the trip pay and the driver's cancellation and no-show fee shares for trips whose drop-off or cancellation falls inside the window, from its start (inclusive) to its end (exclusive); only those earnings count toward a guarantee.

A locked guarantee is not worked out until the earnings account no longer shows a payout hold whose reason has been resolved.

Put the other way round: while the earnings account still shows a payout hold whose reason has been resolved, no locked guarantee is worked out for the opt-in.

## Which offer, and when

| Situation on the account | Opt-in open? |
|---|---|
| The earnings guarantee offer with the latest window start, before that window starts | Yes |
| Any earlier earnings guarantee offer | No |
| The latest earnings guarantee offer, once its window has started | No |

## Tool reference: `opt_in_to_guarantee_dc9f134f`

**Capability.** Opts the driver in to one earnings guarantee offer made to their own earnings account and records the guarantee locked for it. One call records the opt-in, dated now, carrying the offer's market, window and required online time, together with the locked guarantee: the guaranteed amount the driver is held to for that window. The opt-in then shows among the driver's incentive offers and opt-ins.

**How it is invoked.** This is the driver's own tool: the agent unlocks `opt_in_to_guarantee_dc9f134f` and hands it over, and the driver, the customer themselves, runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `earnings_account_id` | The reference number of the driver's own earnings account the offer was made to, as shown by the earnings account lookup | Identifier |
| `bonus_offer_id` | The reference number of the earnings guarantee offer being opted into, as shown by the incentive offer lookup for the driver's account | Identifier |
| `guaranteed_amount` | The locked guarantee recorded on the opt-in, in USD | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (for example 215.30) |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows `optin_id` (the reference number of the recorded opt-in), `source_offer_id` (the offer opted into), `status` "opted_in", `market` (the offer's market code), `window_start` and `window_end` (the offer's window, as a date and time with zone) and `guaranteed_amount` (the locked guarantee in USD, 2 decimal places).

## Hypothetical receipt

An opt-in run with a `guaranteed_amount` of 215.30 returns `status` "opted_in" and `guaranteed_amount` "215.30", with the `window_start` and `window_end` of the offer named by `bonus_offer_id`.
